intro: Read an editorial, separate its claims from its evidence, and follow a counterargument.

bloques.titulo: Track the argument, not just the topic
bloques.texto:
When reading an opinion article, identify the main claim, the reasons offered for it, and any objection the writer acknowledges. A connector can signal how ideas relate: **sin embargo** introduces a contrast; **por ejemplo** gives an illustration; **por tanto** marks a conclusion.

A claim is not automatically evidence. Look for a source, a concrete example or a comparison that supports it. Words such as **algunos**, **en general** and **puede** also limit a statement. They prevent a tendency from sounding like a universal rule.

The text below is a short editorial written for practice. Its recommendations represent the columnist’s view, not a company rule.

bloques.titulo: A schedule for people, not for the clock

frases.es: Cambiar el horario de la oficina no consiste en dejar que cada uno llegue cuando quiera y esperar que todo funcione.
frases.en: Changing the office schedule does not mean letting everyone arrive when they like and hoping that everything works.

frases.es: Si queremos que más compañeros trabajen con calma, primero debemos ofrecer salas silenciosas, buena luz y reuniones bien organizadas.
frases.en: If we want more colleagues to work calmly, we should first provide quiet rooms, good light and well-organised meetings.

frases.es: Quienes estudian por la tarde o tienen desplazamientos largos no siempre pueden llegar temprano; por eso, las normas necesitan excepciones claras.
frases.en: People who study in the afternoon or have long commutes cannot always arrive early, so the rules need clear exceptions.

frases.es: Algunos jefes temen perder el control del trabajo, aunque los horarios flexibles también pueden atraer a quienes prefieren trabajar sin prisas ni atascos.
frases.en: Some managers fear losing control of the work, although flexible hours can also attract people who prefer to work without rush or traffic jams.

frases.es: No basta con afirmar que habrá más productividad: la empresa debería publicar datos antes y después de cada cambio.
frases.en: It is not enough to claim there will be more productivity: the company should publish data from before and after each change.

frases.es: Por más que una medida parezca urgente, será difícil mantenerla si no se explica a quién ayuda y cómo se corregirán sus efectos negativos.
frases.en: However urgent a measure may seem, it will be difficult to maintain unless it is explained who it helps and how its negative effects will be corrected.

frases.es: La meta no debería ser una oficina sin horarios, sino una oficina en la que el horario fijo no sea la única opción práctica.
frases.en: The goal should not be an office without schedules, but an office in which a fixed schedule is not the only practical option.

bloques.pregunta: What is the columnist mainly arguing for?

opciones.Offering practical alternatives before c: The writer argues for measures and alternatives together.
opciones.Removing every schedule in the office im: The conclusion rejects an office with no schedules as the goal.
opciones.Keeping the current schedule unchanged: The text proposes changes and evaluation.

bloques.correcta: Offering practical alternatives before changing the schedule

bloques.pregunta: Which sentence gives a recommendation rather than verifiable evidence?

opciones.Some employees study in the afternoon: This can be checked as a fact about employees.
opciones.Some managers fear losing control of the: This reports a concern attributed to a group.

bloques.correcta: The company should publish data before and after each change

bloques.pregunta: What does the writer concede about people who study in the afternoon or have long commutes?

opciones.They may not be able to arrive early: The article uses this to support clear exceptions.
opciones.They oppose every schedule change: The text does not claim this.
opciones.They always arrive late: The text does not say this.

bloques.correcta: They may not be able to arrive early

bloques.pregunta: Complete: no matter how urgent a measure seems…
bloques.frase: ___ una medida parezca urgente, habrá que evaluar sus efectos.

opciones.Por más que: This concessive expression is followed here by the subjunctive.

bloques.pregunta: Does the text present the proposed schedule as an official decision?

opciones.No, it is an editorial recommendation: The lesson identifies the text as a practice editorial.
opciones.Yes, it is a rule in force today: No rule in force is mentioned.

bloques.correcta: No, it is an editorial recommendation
